name: Color Pop
scaffolding_intent: Desaturates everything except the target so its colors and visible attributes stand out, prompting descriptive noun phrases

parameters.name: desaturationStrength
parameters.description: How much non-target pixels are desaturated

parameters.name: saturationBoost
parameters.description: How much to boost saturation of the active color group

correction_intent: Child stated a wrong visible attribute of an entity: color, size, shape, or clothing ('the red car' for a blue car; 'the tall man' for a short one). Target that entity. Not for non-visible properties like temperature or emotion; that is P2.
suggestion_intent: Child mentioned an entity with a bare noun ('a dog', 'the house') although it has distinctive visible attributes (color, size, pattern, clothing). Target that entity. Requires attributes that are clearly visible and worth describing.
